author: kpedro88
body:
#### PR description:

The tests using the outdated datasets were previously removed from the PR and IB test lists, but can still be enabled on demand. They are no longer strictly necessary even for PU workflows after #51939, as the inputs can all be regenerated locally. It is useful to be able to run some specific Run 3 workflows while features are still being migrated to Phase 2.

@cms-sw/pdmv-l2 this PR only touches the upgrade matrix. There is also a list `baseDataSetRelease` further up in `relval_steps.py`, but I am not sure if it can or should be removed.

#### PR validation:

Ran workflow 17043.13 successfully.
